Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring nursing homes to report methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus infections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring nursing homes to report methicillinresistant staphylococcus aureus infections; and adding a new section tochapter 18.51 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.51 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A nursing home licensed under this chapter shall notify thedepartment of health of any known invasive infection caused bymethicillinresistant staphylococcus aureus occurring within thefacility. (2) The department of health shall adopt rules requiring nursinghomes to submit the information in subsection (1) of this section inthe same manner as other conditions of which nursing homes are requiredto notify the department of health.
